{{Quote|The astroliths arrive with just enough momentum to smash one another into chunks. When those chunks are small enough to transport, they fall down a collection funnel into the repulsi-veyer line and are transported to a grinding mill.|Dena Yus|<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>}}
'''Astroliths''' was a term applied by [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] to fragments leftover following the processing of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] by breaker crews. During the era of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], astroliths were transported to and processed at the [[Sarnus Refinery]], an [[Refinery/Legends|refinery]] complex on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarnus]] in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] nebula. Via a process known as "[[The Drop (process)|The Drop]]", astroliths would be released by breaker crews from the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] of Sarnus and directed via [[repulsor beam]]s and [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] to fall into various crash pits, then funnelled into a [[repulsi-veyer line]] and carried to a grinding mill.<ref name="Crucible" />
 
In [[45 ABY]], the [[biot]] [[Dena Yus]] sabotaged the Sarnus Refinery drop process on behalf of the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] businessmen [[Craitheus Qreph|Qreph]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] by disabling the tractor beam safeguards; a subsequent astrolith drop without these protections [[Destruction of Sarnus Refinery|destroyed]] the refinery and [[Death/Legends|killed]] thirty thousand workers.<ref name="Crucible" />
 
==Behind the scenes==
Astroliths featured in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
